alignment: Floor to last recorded frame at 30 fps. Simulator time excludes inference gaps.
content: Recorded assistant messages and tool calls; no private thinking blocks or editorial summaries.

steps.message: mark_on_map isn't enabled here — I'll track the spawn by odometry instead (spawn is at base pose (0,0), yaw 0, facing the bed). Now let me turn to find the table and red chair.
I see a grey cabinet with a yellow ball on it. Let me keep turning to find the table and red chair.

I found the table with the red chair and the grey toy box (tray) on it. I can see toys on the table: a green box on the left and a yellow/orange flat toy to the right of the tray, plus a yellow ball on the cabinet to the left. I'm at the chair-side spot. Both arms are free (grippers open, arms neutral). I'll start with the yellow toy right next to the tray (easiest, closest). PICK step 2: move_to_reach_point on it.
The reach attempt failed mid pre-lift and left the trunk pitched back (camera pointing at ceiling). I'll restore upright posture with reset_body to recover from this bad pose.
Recovered. Now retrying move_to_reach_point on the yellow toy right of the tray, from the fresh image.
The robot moved very close to the table corner; the yellow toy is visible just beyond the tray. Let me try the grasp planner on it directly from this image.
The planner says the point is too far; the chassis is blocked by the chair. I'll back up slightly, then retry a reach on the near edge of the yellow toy.

Now I understand the layout: tray on the table, yellow flat toy at the table corner, grey cabinet with yellow ball to the right, red chair between me and the table. The yellow toy at the corner is too far across the chair. I'll work on the green box on the other side of the table first. Turning left to face it.
The green "SUPER DO" box is clearly visible on the left. Calling move_to_reach_point on it.
Reach succeeded (shoulder distance 0.66m). Now planning the grasp on the green box body.
Grasp plan failed overlap filters. Retry chain (a): new reach point on the same box, then replan.
Replanning grasp on the box.
Retry chain step b: small lean-in with pitch=-5, then replan.
Replanning after lean-in.
Red overlay confirmed — plan_0001 (right arm). Executing the plan pose.
Exec timed out during the current→safe segment. I'll pull the right arm back to grasp-prep, then re-approach with a fresh plan.
Arm retracted; box unmoved. Step c: new reach on current image, then fresh plan.
Replanning grasp on the box.
Plan pose (plan_0001) is still valid and the world target barely changed. I'll retry executing it once — the previous failure was a tracking timeout, not a grasp failure.
Need a fresh head image first.
Replanning on the fresh image with a different seed.
Same pose keeps failing overlap filters. The chassis drifted too close. I'll back off slightly and re-approach for a fresh plan.
Now re-reach on the box from this slightly farther pose.
Replanning the grasp from this pose.
The successful plan had slightly more lean. I'll add a small extra pitch lean-in and replan.
The successful plan had slightly more lean. I'll add a small extra pitch lean-in and replan.
plan_0002 with red overlay (left arm). Executing now without moving the chassis.
Left gripper is positioned on the box. Closing gripper.
Close was ambiguous — one finger stalled early. The real test is the lift: raising the left EEF +0.2.
Grasp failed — the box stayed on the table and the gripper closed empty. Retract and open the left arm, then redo the sequence.
Arm retracted. Box unmoved. Re-reaching at the box center, then replanning.
Arm retracted. Box unmoved. Re-reaching at the box center, then replanning.
The reach pulled the chassis slightly close again. I'll lean in 3° more (matching the successful pose's pitch), then plan on the fresh image without another reach.
The reach pulled the chassis slightly close again. I'll lean in 3° more (matching the successful pose's pitch), then plan on the fresh image without another reach.
Backing the chassis off 4cm to the pose that previously yielded a valid plan, then replanning directly.
Now at the good pose. Planning grasp directly.
Trying a different sampling seed at this pose.
One more variant: explicitly request the left arm, which succeeded before.
One more pose correction (yaw/pitch back to the previously successful configuration), then plan.
One more pose correction (yaw/pitch back to the previously successful configuration), then plan.
One more pose correction (yaw/pitch back to the previously successful configuration), then plan.
Trying a closer top-down view: lean in further, then replan.
Trying a closer top-down view: lean in further, then replan.
plan_0003 with red overlay on the box (left arm). Executing now.
The exec timed out near the end, but the wrist view shows the gripper right on the box. Attempting the close now.
Grasp confirmed by the gripper logic. Lift test: raise the left EEF +0.2.
Grasp confirmed — the box is lifted with the gripper! Now PLACE: first turn toward the grey toy box tray (it's to my right, ~90° away).
Holding the box with the tray visible left-front. Spinning to face the tray.
Tray is straight ahead. move_to_reach_point on the tray opening.
Tray interior is clear. Tracking toybox_center on the tray floor.
Track bound but the memory snapshot failed to read. Capturing a head image to refresh tracking state and read depth_m.
depth_m = 0.52 ≤ 0.7. Binding both points on the fresh image.
Both tracks live. held_z=1.03 > box_z+0.25=0.99 already. Aligning XY: move held toward center (x=-0.179, y=+0.025).
Partial move; tracks updated. Remaining: x=-0.154, y=+0.022. Moving in smaller steps.
Close: remaining x=-0.073, y=+0.014. Another step.
|dx|=0.004, |dy|=0.006, height OK. Capturing a fresh head image to verify alignment before opening.
The box is offset right of the opening — the body hangs over the tray's right rim. Shifting the held box further toward the opening (-x moves it left in view).
The box now sits well over the opening, but the tray track drifted onto the rim. Rebinding both points on this image.
The box is positioned over the opening (gripper 10cm left of center, box body centered on the opening). Opening the gripper, then the safety withdraw lift.
Gripper opened; the box is released over the tray area. Immediately withdrawing the left arm straight up.
The Skip-Bo box is **inside the grey toy box** — first toy placed! Now parking the left arm (PLACE step 8), then going after the small colorful flat toy visible just past the tray's far corner.
Toy #1 secured. Both arms free. Next: the small colorful flat toy just past the tray's far corner at ~(435,215) in img_0059. PICK step 2 — reach it.
Chassis adjusted (now yaw 130°). The colorful flat toy is visible at ~(380,155) in img_0060. Retrying reach on it.
Reach gate failed (shoulder 0.755). Retry chain step (a): re-reach on a different visible point of the toy — its near/lower corner at ~(370,140).
Retry chain step (b): lean in with pitch −5°.
Re-reach (step c) on the flat toy, now at ~(360,70).
Reach gate stays ~0.75 (toy hugs the wall). Proceeding to the grasp plan directly on it — click at (355,45) on img_0064.
The flat toy is directly ahead but blocked ~0.86 m out with the tray at forward-left. Nudging chassis forward with a slight right offset to close the gap while keeping tray clearance.

Chassis is blocked (obstacle stall) — the flat puzzle toy is beyond reach from any chair-side position. Per the task, I'll skip it for now and move to the tennis ball on the grey cabinet (right side). Turning right to locate it.
Chassis is wedged (spin stalled). Backing away from the table first.
Backing off succeeded (yaw now 60°, at (-0.55,-0.05), bed visible right). Resetting posture to look around for the cabinet ball.
Tennis ball spotted on the grey cabinet (front-left, ~(185,490))! Blue box also visible on the bed at right. Turning toward the cabinet and approaching.
Ball at ~(250,555) on cabinet top. Reaching for it.
Reach gate passed (0.694 m). Planning the grasp on the tennis ball at (330,322).
Excellent plan — grasp volume 57.6 cm³, left arm, red overlay right on the ball. Executing.
Timed out in the current→safe segment (arm barely moved). Retrying execution of the same plan.
Both runs stall in the current→safe segment. Lowering the arm into grasp-prep first (allowed tool), then re-executing the plan (arm motion doesn't stale the base/trunk-frozen plan).
Both runs stall in the current→safe segment. Lowering the arm into grasp-prep first (allowed tool), then re-executing the plan (arm motion doesn't stale the base/trunk-frozen plan).
Execution keeps stalling in the safe segment — the forward-lean trunk (q3=0.57) likely forces a contorted anchor. Straightening the trunk a bit, then replanning fresh.
Replanning grasp on the ball at (335,365) with the new trunk pose.
Stall makes sense: arm is at full extension 33 cm short of the ball. Crawling chassis closer to the cabinet, then fresh reach+plan.
9.7 cm closer. Leaning forward (−10°) to bring shoulders over the cabinet, then fresh capture+plan.
Planning grasp on the ball at (355,355).
Strong plan (56.3 cm³, both arms feasible). Executing left arm.
Left arm stalls in current→safe every time. plan_0005 validated BOTH arms — executing with the right arm instead.
Right arm landed right on the ball (both segments completed!). Closing the gripper.
Grasp confirmed (bilateral, fingers pinched at 0.0175). Lift test with z-only +0.2.
Ball is lifted with the gripper (visible under fingers above the cabinet). Continuing the lift in smaller steps.
Ball is held in the air (~10 cm above cabinet). Carrying it to the tray: first back off from the cabinet.
Backing off OK, ball still pinched. Rotating left ~66° to face the tray.
Tray in view with ball held. PLACE step 2: move_to_reach_point on the tray interior at (270,240).
Chassis moved in (shoulder 0.66 m, ok). Ball is hanging right at the tray rim. Tracking tray center + held ball.
Tracks good (depth 0.577 ≤ 0.7). Step 5: lift the ball above rim+25 cm (need ~+0.17 m).
Right arm too extended for a big lift. First walk the ball toward the tray center in small XY steps (need +0.19 x, +0.17 y).
Ball sits at the tray's near-right corner. Slide chassis forward-left so the tray centers under the ball.
Arm can't extend further. Repositioning: back off, rotate toward the tray head-on, then drive closer so the tray comes to the arm.
Backing off done. Rotate 12° toward the tray and drive in 0.35 m.
Backing off done. Rotate 12° toward the tray and drive in 0.35 m.
Yaw drifted during the drive. Capturing a fresh view to re-ground both tracks.
Tray ended up to my right. Rotating right ~30° to bring the tray ahead of the held ball.
Spin helped — tray is now just right of the ball. Shifting the whole base right ~15 cm to bring the ball over the tray.
Base is wedged. Sweeping the arm right toward the tray opening in small steps (y=−0.10, x=+0.04).
Ball is at the tray's near-left corner. Raising slightly before sweeping over the rim.
Lifted above rim height. Sweeping right over the opening.
One more small right sweep to clear the rim fully.
Ball is over the opening. Executing the drop: open gripper, then withdraw up.
Ball landed just outside the rim on the table. Withdrawing the arm first, then I'll re-grasp it (it's right next to the tray now — short carry).
Park the arm, then re-grasp the ball (fresh cycle) — the re-drop should land inside.
Arm is retracted, gripper free. Re-grasping the ball at (405,315).
plan_0006 valid, right-arm only, grasp_vol 41.6 cm³. Executing with right arm.
Plan executed perfectly — right wrist shows ball in the grasp overlay. Closing gripper.
Grasp confirmed (grasp_confirmed=true, right finger closed on ball). Lifting in 0.1 m increments.
Lift 1 complete (+0.1 m). Continuing lift.
Ball held at z≈0.955, gripper closed. Fresh-tracking tray interior and held ball on img_0110.
Tray is 0.52 m to the right in base frame — too far for arm walk. Rotating chassis right slightly to bring tray more head-on.
Tray is 0.52 m to the right in base frame — too far for arm walk. Rotating chassis right slightly to bring tray more head-on.
Ball at (0.584,−0.055,0.997), box at (0.750,−0.302,0.752). Need more right-rotation. Trying another spin.
Spin wedged (chassis stuck against table). Doing XY arm walk right/forward over the opening instead.
Walk worked fully. Final nudge forward+right and small height restore.
Walk worked fully. Final nudge forward+right and small height restore.
Ball landed INSIDE the tray on top of the Skip-Bo — toy #2 scored! Withdrawing the arm per protocol.
Tennis ball is settled in the tray (toy #2 ✓). Parking right arm.
Right arm parked open. Tray now holds Skip-Bo + tennis ball (2 toys ✓). Puzzle toy at far right remains out of reach. Backing off toward the bed.
Right arm parked open. Tray now holds Skip-Bo + tennis ball (2 toys ✓). Puzzle toy at far right remains out of reach. Backing off toward the bed.
Right arm parked open. Tray now holds Skip-Bo + tennis ball (2 toys ✓). Puzzle toy at far right remains out of reach. Backing off toward the bed.
180° rotation completed — now facing the bed. Both boxes (blue + green-white) visible near the headboard. Advancing to bed foot.
At bed foot. Entering left corridor: translate left, then drive toward headboard.
Left corridor aligned. Driving forward toward headboard.
Chassis veered into bed corner. Correcting: spin left, then forward.
Chassis veered into bed corner. Correcting: spin left, then forward.
Chassis swung into the bed side. Backing off and re-orienting.
Chassis swung into the bed side. Backing off and re-orienting.
Clear corridor to headboard. Advancing.
At corridor end, boxes close on the right. Working green-and-white box: move_to_reach_point.
Gate passed (shoulder 0.598 m). Planning grasp on green-and-white box at (445,260).
Green box too far through the bed. Blue box is closer to the corridor — re-reaching to it.
Re-positioned closer. Planning grasp on blue box at (378,292).
Red overlay on blue box — plan_0007 valid (right arm). Executing.
Blue box (Balderdash) framed in the gripper. Closing.
Blue box (Balderdash) framed in the gripper. Closing.
Blue box is airborne — grasp holds. Lifting further.
Blue box carried clear. Turning to head back down the corridor to the table.
Corridor open ahead with cabinet/chair beyond. Driving out.
Corridor open ahead with cabinet/chair beyond. Driving out.
Bed corner dragged yaw again. Re-orienting toward the table (west) and continuing around the bed foot.
Table in view ahead with red chair. Closing in.
At the table but offset right. Rotating toward the tray and approaching.

Arms are raised now. Retrying the retreat with right bias to clear the slab.
Retreat fully stalled (0.007m). Trying pure right translation to slide along the slab face.
Popped free! Base now (1.675, −3.122), yaw 21°. Continuing right-translation toward the open south strip.
Slid another 0.06m, now at (1.692, −3.179), yaw 11°. Spinning right to face south-southwest and drop into the open south strip.
Spin delivered −70° (now facing −59°, open floor ahead per img_0269). Continuing the turn to face west-southwest.
Spin stalled (only −0.5°). Moving forward first onto open floor, then will re-aim.
Ran into a dark cabinet at y≈−3.67; right gripper got pinched closed. Unpinching arms first.
Arms still pressed against the cabinet. Backing away north first.
Arms freed, backing off to (1.785, −3.501). Retreat a bit more, then turn west.
Under the cabinet overhang, facing south. Turning right to face west along the strip.
Facing due west (yaw 180°) on open floor. Advancing west in bursts.
West progress! Now (1.397, −3.474). Another westward burst.
Through the pinch — two westward bursts succeeded. Left gripper pinched again; unpinching, then continuing west.
Left arm jammed against the desk. Translating right to separate, then will re-open.
Arms free at (0.912, −3.600). Turning right to face due west, then continue to x≈0.3.
Facing west on open floor. Advancing 0.45m.
At (0.486, −3.484), yaw 145° (dragged toward desk). Continuing forward to clear the desk's west side.
Blocked by desk's west corner at (0.325, −3.335). Spinning to face west to clear it.
Turned out to (0.071, −3.200) yaw 177°. Now turning right to face north toward spawn.
Spin locked at this spot. Moving forward (west) 0.3m first to reach a roomier spot.
Forward blocked by furniture edge. Backing south-left to re-open space, then reassess route north.
Clear at (0.142, −3.341). Turning right ~51° to face north, then probing the lane north past the desk's east face.
Facing north with clear floor ahead. Probing north 0.4m.
Northbound lane opening. Advancing another 0.4m north.
Stalled just short. Nudging forward-right to clear the cabinet corner.
Blocked at (0.144, −2.820). Shifting left (west) to center the gap, then forward again.
Gap too tight at x≈0.1. Backing off to route around the table's east side.
Backed to (0.116, −3.176). Turning to face east-northeast, then will traverse east before heading north.
Facing ENE (yaw 20°). Moving east 0.5m toward the open area between table and bed.
Right gripper jammed closed again. Unpinching arms.
Right gripper jammed closed again. Unpinching arms.
Arms clear at (0.639, −3.225). Turning left to face north.
Facing 56° (NE) at (0.608, −3.119). Advancing NE 0.4m to probe the gap.
Slab wall confirmed across x 0.6–1.7 at y≈−3.0. Routing east to the open zone, then north around the slab's east end. Turning east.
Facing east. Driving east 0.5m toward the open zone.
Full 0.5m east to (1.113, −3.204). Another east burst.
(1.599, −3.312) — east continues clear. Next burst.
Blocked at (1.982, −3.396) — likely bed foot. Turning to face north to probe the lane here.
A NE lane between two white faces. Advancing into it 0.4m.
Too tight here. Backing out and shifting east first.
Backed clear. Turning east to run out to the open zone and probe north along the east side.
Facing east. Running out east 0.5m.
East is blocked here. Probing forward-right around the obstacle.
Nose is pushing under something — same bed-frame pattern. Retreating immediately.
Retreated cleanly. Final test of the pinch-gap route: running up west, then driving NE through it.
Lower lane (y≈−3.7) facing east — trying east past the low obstacle.
East capped at x≈2.36. Getting a wider view — pitching head up slightly and capturing.
Corner confirmed. Turning north to inspect the lane along the east wall.
Corner squeeze again. Retreating out.
Regrouping: heading back west to the proven north lane. Turning west.
Westbound from the south wall lane.
West continues. Another 0.5m.
West continues. Another 0.5m.
West continues. Another 0.5m.
West continues. Another 0.5m.

Nook dead-end. Backing out to reroute through the gap between drawer unit and cabinet.
Backed out (+0.25m), grippers free (0.05). Now turning east to run the south lane toward the untested gap at x≈1.1.
Yaw 77°, floor ahead but object at 0.38m. Continuing turn to due east for the lane run.
Facing east at (0.34,−3.80), lane clear. Advancing east.
Severe yaw drag (−79°) dragged me south of the lane, now at (0.72,−4.03) yaw −78° facing dark obstruction, grippers pinching. Backing out north.
At bed's south edge, grippers recovered. Turning away from the bed magnet — spin +90 first.
